slot.brief: Match vitamins as fat/water soluble or list deficiency disease / chemical name of a given vitamin

stem: Deficiency of which vitamin causes beri-beri?
notes: from question bank ga560c5dbf266 (verified in job 20261127-132429-aa8a)
working:
Vitamin $\text{B}_1$ (thiamine) deficiency causes beri-beri.

Independent check: Beriberi is caused by a deficiency of thiamine (vitamin B₁).
solution: Beriberi is caused by deficiency of thiamine, also called vitamin $\text{B}_1$.
